gsm8k_semantic_Qwen3.5-0.8B_baseline.note: 18/200 cases from semantic-failure cohort (biased toward hard cases); accuracy not comparable to Exp 235 full-cohort 14% until run completes

claims.note: Arithmetic regex (_ARITHMETIC_RE) extracted claims from only 5/18 cases. Cases with no extractable equation-form arithmetic have zero formal claims and therefore cannot be flagged by the solver — they constitute implicit abstentions at the case level.

gsm8k_semantic.note: Only arithmetic route observed in 18 GSM8K cases so far. Cardinality and set_membership routes appear in constraint_ir benchmark (not yet executed).

constraint_ir.note: No constraint_ir cases executed yet. Based on Exp 221 schema, expected routes are cardinality (word_count_range, sentence_count, step_count) and set_membership (must_include_token, must_include_phrase, forbidden_token, enum_membership). Exp 221 flagged 60/81 cases for Qwen3.5 and 31/81 for Gemma4.

abstain_mechanism_comparison.exp235_semantic_verifier_v2: verdict-level abstain when monitorability_confidence < threshold; 76.5% Qwen, 65.5% Gemma
abstain_mechanism_comparison.exp247_solver_routed: implicit case-level abstain when arithmetic regex extracts zero claims; 72.2% so far in partial Qwen baseline
abstain_mechanism_comparison.preliminary_finding: Abstain rates are similar in magnitude (72% vs 77% for Qwen) but the mechanism has shifted from confidence-gated semantic abstention to structural extraction failure. This is not a strict improvement: solver routes only fire when the response contains explicit equation-form arithmetic (A OP B = C), so verbally-reasoned or chain-of-thought responses without explicit equations yield zero claims and therefore cannot be flagged.

false_positive_comparison.exp247_partial_Qwen: 1 violated claim in 18 cases; whether this is a FP cannot be determined from partial baseline data (verify_only mode not yet run)
false_positive_comparison.note: Full FP analysis requires verify_only and verify_repair cells to complete. Cannot conclude from 18 baseline cases.

comparison_to_exp235.primary_question_status: BLOCKED — Cannot yet determine whether solver-routed claims materially improve the verify-only budget or only shift work into abstention. The partial data (18/200 baseline only) shows similar case-level abstain rates but via a structurally different mechanism. A full run is needed.

comparison_to_exp221.note: No constraint_ir cells have executed. The constraint_ir benchmark is the primary venue for cardinality and set_membership routes. Until those cells complete, route-level evidence for structured constraint verification cannot be reported.

arithmetic.precision_note: 1/5 violated claims = 20% violation rate; insufficient sample for reliable precision/recall estimates
arithmetic.fp_budget_note: If the 1 violated claim corresponds to a correct response (FP), FP rate = 100%. If it corresponds to a wrong response, it is a true positive. Cannot determine without ground truth alignment — requires verify_only mode results.
arithmetic.coverage_note: 5 claims extracted from 18 cases = 27.8% claim extraction rate. 13/18 cases (72.2%) have no extractable arithmetic claims and therefore receive implicit abstention.

claim_level_abstain_rate.interpretation: Deterministic solver routes (arithmetic, cardinality, set_membership) never abstain at the claim level — they always return supported or violated. The abstention problem relocates to claim extraction: if no claims are extractable from a response, the verifier produces no verdicts. This is the structural extraction abstention.

case_level_no_claim_rate.interpretation: Preliminary: solver-routed extraction covers slightly more cases (72.2% silence vs 76.5% abstain) but the difference is within sampling noise at n=18. A complete run is required.

false_positive_budget.note: False positive rate requires verify_only mode results to identify flagged-but-correct cases. Only partial baseline data is available. No conclusions can be drawn yet.
false_positive_budget.anticipated_fp_mechanism: For arithmetic route: a violated claim on a correct response would constitute a FP. This can only be assessed by cross-referencing the 'correct' flag from baseline with the 'flagged' flag from verify_only — a cross-mode comparison requiring both cells to complete.

repair_yield.note: verify_repair mode not yet executed for any cell.

detected_wrong_answers.note: Cross-referencing wrong answers with violated flags requires verify_only mode. Not yet available.

direct_comparison_verdict.question: Did solver-routed claims materially improve the verify-only budget compared to semantic_verifier_v2, or only shift work into abstention?
direct_comparison_verdict.answer: CANNOT DETERMINE FROM CURRENT DATA — run is 18/200 baseline cases for one model, all other cells blocked by runtime budget.
direct_comparison_verdict.preliminary_structural_observation: Solver-routed formal claims eliminate claim-level abstention (0% vs 76.5% for semantic_verifier_v2) but replace it with structural extraction abstention: 72.2% of Qwen3.5 responses on GSM8K yield zero extractable arithmetic claims. The arithmetic regex (A OP B = C form) has low extraction coverage (~28%) because Qwen3.5-0.8B responses frequently compute without writing explicit balanced equations. This means the solver's determinism is underutilized: it fires precisely when it fires, but it fires rarely.
direct_comparison_verdict.hypothesis_for_full_run: If arithmetic extraction coverage stays near 28%, solver-routed verification will flag fewer cases than semantic_verifier_v2 (which had 100% parse coverage). The question is whether the cases it does flag are higher precision (fewer FP). The 1 violated claim in 18 cases is insufficient to compute precision. Constraint-IR (set_membership and cardinality) may show better coverage since those routes match structural response features rather than equation syntax.
direct_comparison_verdict.exp235_showed: semantic_verifier_v2 was not sufficient: high abstain rate (76.5% for Qwen), negative verify_only delta (-2%), and modest repair yield (+1%). The primary failure mode was semantic abstention, not false positives.
direct_comparison_verdict.exp247_early_signal: The solver-routed approach has similar abstain magnitude but different mechanism. Whether it solves the root cause (low wrong-answer detection: 17.4% for Qwen) requires the full run.
